completionStatus.description: Completed or off-plan. Applies to sale listings only.
completionStatus.title: Completion status

emirate.description: Limit the search to one emirate, or search all seven emirates. Used by the sale and rent modes.
emirate.title: Emirate

furnished.description: PropertyFinder filters furnished and unfurnished server-side; semi-furnished is matched from the listing's published status.
furnished.title: Furnishing

includeDetails.description: Adds the full photo gallery, community and tower photos, floor plans, broker licence, permit validation link, agent stats and building facts. One extra page per listing.
includeDetails.title: Fetch full listing details

maxBedrooms.description: Optional upper bedroom limit; leave empty for no cap.
maxBedrooms.title: Maximum bedrooms

maxItems.description: Stop after this many matching listings. PropertyFinder caps a single query at about 4,000 pages; narrow the filters to reach deeper.
maxItems.title: Maximum listings

maxPrice.description: Maximum asking price in UAE dirhams.
maxPrice.title: Maximum price (AED)

minBedrooms.description: 0 means studio. Bedroom filters apply to residential types only.
minBedrooms.title: Minimum bedrooms

minPrice.description: Minimum asking price in UAE dirhams.
minPrice.title: Minimum price (AED)

mode.description: Search all UAE listings, or paste exact PropertyFinder URLs (detail pages, landing pages or search pages).
mode.title: What to scrape

propertyType.description: Residential types use the standard sale/rent pages; office, shop, warehouse and factory use the commercial pages.
propertyType.title: Property type

propertyUrls.description: Used by the URL mode. Accepts detail pages, /to/ short links, and landing or search pages (which are paginated). Mixed valid and invalid URLs are processed individually.
propertyUrls.title: PropertyFinder URLs
